messages:
Iris: ping — customer reported being billed twice after a streaming session was truncated mid-response and then the tool was replayed on reconnect. ledger shows two confirmed writes. anyone seen this pattern?
Noah: yep. we treat toolcall_done as final. that breaks for streaming because GC can trim suffix before client sees it.
Iris: snippet from trace (redacted):
```
router: gc_trim session=s-321 seq=158 reason=kv_eviction
stream: truncate session=s-321 truncated_tokens=28
toolcall: id=tool-7 status=ok returned=20
client: reconnect session=s-321b resume_from=156
toolcall: id=tool-7 status=ok returned=20 (replayed)
ledger: write confirmed tenant=acct-9 tokens=40
```
Priya: Proposed change: write toolcall token entries as provisional by default for streaming sessions, attach a commit_hint (router-provided), and only flip to confirmed on client_commit/ack. Also add canonical_toolcall_id to dedupe.
Diego: sounds good. data model idea: provisional_ledger (tenant, canonical_toolcall_id, commit_hint, tokens, state=provisional, created_at). reconcile worker groups on commit_hint and emits confirmed aggregate. TTL on provisional rows (7d) for orphan handling.
Noah: short-term mitigation: ledger will ignore duplicate canonical_toolcall_id writes within 90s if token counts match exactly. it's imperfect but quick.
Priya: telemetry asks: provisional_writes_total, provisional_reconciles_total, duplicate_toolcall_hits, reconcile_latency_seconds_p95. add tag for feature_flag=on/off.
Iris: console ask: in request detail view show "pending tokens" badge and a compact timeline: [toolcall (provisional)] -> [commit_ack] -> [confirmed]. hover text explains provisional semantics. support should be able to filter requests with pending>0.
Diego: rollout plan: feature flag billing.prov_tokens_v1. enable on staging, then 5% hosted traffic, dedicated opt-in 100%. monitor duplicate rate and reconcile latency.
Noah: perf caveat: provisional writes increase DB load. implement append-only table with TTL and a fast reconcile path to compact entries into confirmed ledger ASAP.
Priya: SDK contract: clients should emit commit_ack when they receive the final suffix/end-of-stream. fallback: if no ack, TTL expires and provisional entries become orphaned; reconcile marks them as rolled_back and emits an incident event if rate > threshold.
Iris: repro steps for QA:
1) run router with kv_ttl=50ms
2) stream ~200 tokens, trigger toolcall at seq ~150
3) force GC midstream, reconnect to different router that will replay the toolcall
Expect: only one confirmed charge after reconcile. Current: two confirmed.
Diego: owners: Noah (ledger schema + short-term dedupe), Priya (console + docs), Iris (RFC + rollout), I'll do reconcile worker.
metrics-bot: alert drafted: billing.prov.duplicate_rate > 0.3% over 5m -> notify #eng-oncall. reconcile.latency.p95 > 30s -> notify #eng-oncall.
ops-bot: canary deploy queued for branch prov-ledger/iris. targets: staging-canary-1.
Iris: thanks — I'll post RFC and sequence diagrams in this thread. add any missing failure modes in comments. :white_check_mark:
